submittedArguments.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. This is a targeted local restoration of an existing Daoist Q-style hand-painted coastal map, not a new scene. Image 1 is the exact 1254 x 1254 native edit target. Return one native 1254 x 1254 PNG with exactly the same framing, scale, camera, palette, rock positions, object identities and registration. Repair only the small offshore rock left wing near local x450–645,y460–655: an angular water wedge cuts diagonally through the rock and there is a second unnatural straight rock-surface cut below it. Restore the left rock lobe as a continuous rounded gray rock, with coherent stone lighting and a continuous white foam contact line at the water. Keep the rock footprint and existing sand/water boundary. Do not add a new boulder. Change only the described defects inside crop-local rectangle [280, 300, 820, 780]. Preserve every pixel outside that allowed rectangle as closely as possible, especially the outer 115 pixels on every side. Away from the defects do not repaint, smooth or recolor anything. Preserve fine matte hand-painted gray/slate stone, warm sunlight, sand and existing shadows. Correct the geometry and light continuity at original native detail; no blur, feather haze, resizing, perspective shift, invented content, buildings, UI, lettering or watermark. Fixed unchanged context around the repair is essential for seamless native patch insertion.
